slices.focus: Ariana wins approval for cloud storage, drive rotation, and environmental monitoring
slices.summary: Ariana's blunt incident memo leads board approval for off-site cloud storage, a second local hard-drive rotation, and a dedicated environmental monitoring budget. She shifts from rescue mode to building repeatable backup and monitoring routines.
